_comment: Registry for /style-tag (.claude/commands/style-tag.md): the Master Flooring Catalogue style-tag fields, what may decide each one, the thresholds and rule tables scripts/style_tag_plan.py applies, the staged write_mode, and where a run writes. Consumed by scripts/style_tag_pull.py, scripts/style_tag_plan.py, .claude/agents/airtable-actions-agent.md (the closed field list) and the command. Field ids verified live 2026-09-26 (list_tables_for_base + get_table_schema). Ids are stable across renames; names are not — prefer the id wherever the API accepts one. Method and rubric: methods/style-tags.md.
_maintenance: Option strings are EXACT MATCH against Airtable (`Warm`, not `warm`); the plan script pre-flights every value here against a fresh get_table_schema read and stops if one is missing — never add the option. Thresholds and rule tables are tunable data (architecture.md: a value you might change next month lives here); what they MEAN is in methods/style-tags.md. tests/test_style_tags.py holds this file to platform-settings/airtable-master-catalogue-fields.json and to the actions agent's closed field list.

write_mode._flip: Staged rollout, same shape as social-destinations.json write_mode. While `plan_only`, /style-tag builds the plan, the troubled CSV and the Notion report and writes NO approval file and NO Airtable record — scripts/style_tag_plan.py refuses --write-approval under it. Flipping to `write` is a dated decision recorded in the vault (05_decisions/), never an edit made to get a run through. tests/test_style_tags.py guards the value; update the test in the same commit as the flip (test_social_registry.py went stale exactly this way on 2026-09-2x).

targets._comment: The five tag fields a run may fill, BLANK ONLY. Order here is the order tags appear in evidence and in the troubled CSV.

Tone depth._note: A rating field, not a number: write an integer 1-5. 1 = very light, 5 = very dark.

status_field.name: Style tags status
status_field._note: A run sets `AI suggested` only when it writes at least one tag and the field is blank. It NEVER writes `Staff confirmed` — that is a person's click in Airtable (D5, 2026-09-26). A record already `Staff confirmed` is excluded at pull, at plan, and again at write time.

evidence_field.name: Style tags evidence
evidence_field._note: Appended, never replaced: existing text + newline + this run's block. Block = header line `AI suggested <date> — <plan path>` then one line per written tag `Field: Value (confidence, source[: image filename]) — evidence`. No tag is written without an evidence line.

inputs._comment: Read, never written. The three image fields (Albert, 2026-09-26: `Images` renamed to `Swatch images`, same id; Room scene and Detail added) plus the specs the rule tables and the model read.

image_fields._comment: Key -> live field name and the manifest `kind`. The KIND IS THE SOURCE FIELD, never the model's guess: which field an attachment sits in decides what it may inform (image_sources). The model's `looks_like` is a sanity check that can only withhold a misfiled image.

image_sources._comment: Albert, 2026-09-26, verbatim: 'Colour tags (Undertone, Tone depth) come from Swatch images only; never from Room scene images (room lighting skews colour). Style uses swatch + room scenes. Texture uses specs + Detail images. No swatch -> hold colour tags for review.'

source_rules._comment: Which sources may DECIDE a field. `spec` = the rule tables below; `swatch_images` / `room_scene_images` / `detail_images` = the model's judgement of an image in that field; `hint` = supplier colour words and `Colour / tone`, confidence-capped so they never write alone. A `reviewer` answer (troubled table `Action` cell) may decide any field. Anything not listed is never a source for that field — a room scene cannot reach Undertone at any confidence.

_eligible_note: v1 is flooring only (D2, 2026-09-26). Tile / Stone needs its own texture table (polished / honed / glazed / splitface) and its busyness is veining, not grain — added when asked for. Accessory, STONE and Carpet are out.

policy._note: A tag writes only if: the field is blank (at pull AND at write), the record is not Staff confirmed, confidence >= min_confidence after caps, no spec-vs-image conflict, and the value is a live option. agreement_bonus is added (capped at 1.0) when two independent sources name the same value; disagreement at >= min_confidence on both sides is a conflict, never an average. spec_only_style_cap keeps Style below threshold on a record with no swatch or room image (D4). hint_confidence is what supplier colour words and `Colour / tone` are worth on their own — never enough.

spec_rules._comment: Deterministic tables scripts/style_tag_plan.py applies. Finish matching normalises the option string (lowercase, letters and digits only, single spaces) because the live `Finish type` list carries a dozen spellings of wire-brushed; rules are tried top to bottom, first match wins. Anything unmatched is held `spec_unmapped` and named in the troubled CSV — grow these tables from real rows, never by guessing at run time. Rules marked provisional write `wrote_flagged` (`spec_rule_provisional`) below min_confidence they simply hold.

texture_from_finish.why: scraping, distressing and saw marks are deliberate rustic texture
any wire-brushed finish, light or deep
PROVISIONAL: vinyl/laminate grain embossing is neither smooth nor brushed wood. Held at 0.6 until Albert rules on it — see methods/style-tags.md, open rulings
a coating with no brush or scrape word is a smooth face

grade_letter_map._comment: bert-airtable-schema 'Letter-grade mapping' — letter grades collapse to the canonical four before the busyness lookup.

Select Plus.why: verbatim supplier grade; not formally mapped per bert-airtable-schema

Prestige Grade.why: verbatim supplier grade; not formally mapped

Excel Grade.why: verbatim supplier grade; not formally mapped

Distressed.why: live option without the word Grade; finish language stored as a grade

BCDE.why: PROVISIONAL: a letter grade the schema skill does not map

busyness_modifiers.why: distressing, smoking, reactive stains and saw marks add visual variation
the catalogue already says the colour varies

tone_depth_from_colour_tone._comment: `Colour / tone` (only its seven canonical values; the ~130 supplier colour codes on that select are ignored) as a HINT for Tone depth at hint_confidence. `range` is what counts as agreement with the image; `proposed` is the value offered when the hint is all there is (never enough to write).

colour_words._comment: Whole-word, case-insensitive, over `Product name` + `Collection`. Hints at hint_confidence for Undertone (warm/cool/neutral) and Tone depth (light -> 2, dark -> 4).

_style_note: Style is the model's judgement over specs + swatch + room scene images (D6: the session model writes the judgement file; contracts/style-plan-schema.md 'The judgement file'). The rubric it follows is prose in methods/style-tags.md; the script only thresholds, caps and validates.

notion_row._comment: D1 (2026-09-26): one STANDING row per scope in the Price Lists database — data_source from platform-settings/pricelist-sources.json -> price_lists.data_source, property names from its read_properties / write_properties. Found by title; created on the first run; Troubled Files and the page table replaced each run with Action cells carried forward.
notion_row._tag_note: Coined under the 2026-09-11 open-ended-tag rule (pricelist-sources.json tags._open_ended_2026-09-11): a gray tag, never Regular List / Promo, colour set on the new option only.
notion_row._properties_note: So no present or future sweep mistakes the row for a price list: the extraction routine stops on any status past Not started, and the (unwired) backstop sweep filters Airtable Sync Pending/Partial.

outputs._images_note: ingest/<date>/style-images/<sku>/<kind>/<attachment_id>-<filename> plus a downscaled `<attachment_id>-read.jpg` beside it for the model. Gitignored: product photos are Airtable's copy, regenerable, and would bloat the repo. The manifest in the candidates file stores ids and filenames, never the signed URLs (they expire within hours).
